title: helm: stabilize private values templating and init hooks for upgrade/rollback
author: Priya Patel
description: Motivation: customers running Redwood Private reported upgrade/rollback failures when custom values used templated tolerations/nodeSelector and when init job hooks touched PVCs. This PR stabilizes the values schema and Helm templating helpers for initJobs and hooks to ensure deterministic behavior across upgrade and rollback paths. Summary of changes: 1) tighten values.schema.json to explicitly allow templated expressions for tolerations/nodeSelector and add clear deprecation path for legacy 'psp' fields; 2) add _helpers.tpl helpers for sanitized templating of map/list fields to avoid nil/empty rendering during upgrades; 3) rewrite init-jobs.yaml to split init jobs into pre-upgrade and post-install hooks and add conditional annotations to prevent duplicate job runs during rollback; 4) add rollback-hook.yaml to gracefully drain init-job resources and preserve nodeSelector/toleration settings when charts are rolled back; 5) add migration script notes and a Helm test to cover upgrade->rollback->upgrade loop. Testing: added unit tests for template helper outputs and a CI helm integration test that runs install->upgrade->rollback on a small k3s cluster in the CI matrix. Also ran manual validation on an internal dedicated cluster with customer-like values. Rollout notes: non-breaking to existing installs but operators should run the included migration helm hook when upgrading across the minor version to ensure legacy PSP/nodeSelector values are migrated into the new schema. See release notes. Related: linked Linear items ENG-2021, INF-334.
commits: Refactor values schema validation and allow templated nodeSelector/tolerations
Add template helpers for list/map sanitization in charts/redwood-private/templates/_helpers.tpl
Split init jobs into pre-upgrade/post-install hooks and add conditional annotations
Add rollback hook to cleanup/reconcile init job artifacts
Add helm integration test for upgrade->rollback->upgrade loop
Docs: helm/README.md update with migration instructions and examples
review_comments: Marco Liu: Please ensure the helper preserves empty maps vs null to avoid unnecessary diffs (addressed in commit 3)
Priya Patel: Updated helpers to render '{}' for empty map and '[]' for empty lists; added unit tests
Ethan Rivera: Need to ensure rollback hook is idempotent for repeated rollbacks (added conditional annotation and reconciliation logic)
Sofia Gomez: Add a note about migration hook side-effects to helm/README.md (done)
Marco Liu: Verified CI helm integration test locally and approved the change
release_notes: Fix: stabilize Helm templating for private values to avoid upgrade/rollback regressions. Operators should run the provided migration hook when upgrading across the minor version to migrate legacy PSP/nodeSelector values. Adds Helm tests for the upgrade->rollback->upgrade loop.
notes_for_operators: Run `helm upgrade --install --wait --post-renderer ./scripts/migrate-psp.sh` or the included migration hook before performing a full cluster upgrade. The migration is safe to run multiple times but will no-op after migration completes.
